text:
Type: white picture frame with mat
Use: displaying a photo, print or poster on a wall or a shelf; living room, bedroom, home office, hallway
Style: classic, Scandinavian, traditional
Materials: painted wood-look frame with a moulded profile, off-white passe-partout mat, clear front panel
Colors: white frame, warm off-white mat
Shape: portrait rectangle with a stepped, softly profiled border and a wide mat around the picture, flat to the wall, light and tidy
Feel: neat, bright, gentle, timeless
Goes with: black and white photos, botanical prints, light wood, pale walls; Scandinavian, classic or farmhouse rooms

product.name: VIRSERUM
product.description: The mount enhances the picture and makes framing easy.
